title: AO/350/2008 of NATIONAL INSURANCE CO. LTD. Vs SMT. SABIRA KHATOON AND OTHERS

paras.text:
MCC No.270 of 2020
In
AO no.350 of 2008
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.

Mr. S.K. Chaudhary, Advocate for
respondent nos.1 to 4.
Instant miscellaneous application has
been moved by the respondent nos.1 to 4 to
remit the balance amount deposited by the
appellant pursuant to order dated 22.08.2008
before this Court to the Tribunal concerned.
By order dated 22.08.2008, this Court had
directed the appellant to deposit the entire
awarded amount before this Court, and the
same was directed to be kept in a Fixed Deposit.
Pursuant to said order, the appellant deposited
an amount of ` 16,88,751/-. However, 50% of
the said amount was withdrawn in favour of the
claimants under the orders passed in money
withdrawal application. Now, rest of the amount
is still lying in FDR.
In the above circumstances, Registry is
directed to remit the remaining amount along
with the interest accrued thereon, if any, to the
Tribunal concerned as expeditiously as possible.
